_comment: TRU★MEN brand for the shorts. Palette is the LOCKED July 12, 2026 sheet, which already lives in this repository (../four-rules-reels/brand/tokens.json and the site CSS); the handoff's provisional values were superseded on adoption — see docs/CHANGELOG.md. A test asserts the three copies agree.

paletteUse.cream: paper, light, skin highlights, caption plates
paletteUse.gold: the star facets in the supplied lockup only

type._comment: Georgia is used for titles and captions when it is licensed and installed on the render machine; otherwise Gelasio (metric-compatible, SIL OFL, vendored under assets/fonts). Poppins Bold Italic is for the TRU★MEN wordmark only. The typeface actually in force is recorded in every manifest.

titleLockup._comment: Green § above the title, scales beneath, per the locked identity.

companyMark._comment: The supplied lockup (TRU★MEN PRODUCTIONS · VIRI VERI on navy, 2400×1131) is used as-is. The star is never smaller than the letters. If the file is missing the engine typesets a placeholder in Poppins Bold Italic and says so in the manifest.

look.style: limited-palette cut-paper: flat shapes, visible grain, hard shadows, brass used sparingly. A court exhibit that learned to move.
